_doc: Render massing for the Nationaal Leiemonument (Leiegedenkteken, Koning Albertpark; protected monument; WWII memorial of the Battle of the Leie, May 1940), read by pipeline/src/scene.ts. No GRB footprint (empty replace_oidn: a free-standing object). DHMV II: the pylon tip at ~24.5 m above the ground (under-sampled) about 1.5 m east, 2 m south of the Google Maps pin. Look (Google Street View from the park, Google Maps photos, look-up only; tracesofwar.com): a tall slender white-grey stone pylon on a stepped terrace, in front of it (south-west) a dark bronze equestrian statue of King Leopold III with standing soldiers, a long low grey stone wall around the lawn.
